decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing numbers 109.090, 109.100, 109.110, 109.111, 109.120, 109.121, 109.130, 109.140, 109.200, 109.205, 109.210, 109.300, 109.301 and 109.400, dated 29th May 2025.

The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those specified in drawing numbers 109.205 and 109.400 dated 29th May 2025 and thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, including any ground excavation and clearance works, a tree protection plan in accordance with BS5837:2012 shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and thereafter implemented in accordance with the approved details for the duration of the construction phase.</p>

<p>The flat roof area of the single-storey extension hereby approved shall be accessed for the purpose of maintenance only and shall not be used as a terrace/balcony nor access provided over for use as amenity space at any time.</p>

<p>The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the residential dwellinghouse at no. 6 Pembroke Road and for no other purpose. The outbuilding shall not be open for use by the occupier’s staff or visiting clients and it shall not be used for any form of permanent living or sleeping accommodation.</p>
description: Construction of a single storey side extension and outbuilding, installation of timber cladding to existing extension, formation of a garden patio, creation of an internal courtyard and replacement windows and doors at rear. (Amended description)
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
